name: prism
description: Root task runner. Nothing is built or published from here — this exists so the nine processes the stack needs can be started with one command instead of nine terminals.

scripts.up: npm run stop:apps && node scripts/ensure-docker.js && npm run deps && npm run dev
scripts.stop: npm run stop:apps && npm run deps:down
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n api,recognition,redaction,purge,item-action,export,reaper,retention,user,admin -c blue,magenta,yellow,red,greenBright,cyanBright,white,gray,green,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:recognition" "npm run dev:redaction" "npm run dev:purge" "npm run dev:item-action" "npm run dev:export" "npm run dev:reaper" "npm run dev:retention" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.migrate: npm --prefix backend exec -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.lint: npm --prefix user-portal run lint && npm --prefix admin-portal run lint
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix user-portal ci && npm --prefix admin-portal ci
